description: Parse a PDF to structured Markdown (hallucination-guarded OCR for scanned pages, Japanese-strong). Pass url (one step: the 402 quotes the exact price for that PDF) or quote_id from quote_parse (price fixed by the quote). One of the two is required. Choose this when the input is a PDF and you want its full text as Markdown; call pdf_info first if you do not know whether it is scanned, and use document_pipeline instead for invoices you also want verified.

quote_id.description: quote_id returned by quote_parse (price is fixed by the quote)

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the PDF (one-step form)

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.

name: parse_document

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)

title: Parse Document
